Keep A55–C35 absent, the B28–B35 1 kohm resistor, B50–B23, D55–D60 load and C23–A60 REF return, and all specimen wiring unchanged. Remove probes and reconnect the same USB port.

outcome.reason: Electrical/reference guard failed; no next stimulus

note_after: Later: the reference drift was traced to a bad ground return wire on the bench. It was replaced on 3 Nov, and the unchanged guard then passed QA (block-mean span A3 0.37 mV, A4 0.48 mV against the 3 mV limit).
